create.name: Jill Shepherd
create.bio:
Jill Shepherd is an insight meditation teacher based in Auckland, Aotearoa New Zealand. Her practice began in Thailand in 1999, and in the years since she has lived at meditation centres and monasteries in Thailand, Australia, England and the United States, including a seven-year stint on the staff of the Insight Meditation Society in Massachusetts, where she sat long retreats, studied the Buddhist texts and taught a weekly class in a nearby prison. She trained as a teacher in the joint IMS and Spirit Rock programme led by Joseph Goldstein and Gil Fronsdal, finishing in 2016.

Today she divides her year mainly between New Zealand, Australia and the US. She leads silent vipassana and brahmavihara retreats, from nine days to several weeks, and guides personal retreats at the Forest Refuge in Barre. At home she is guiding teacher of the Auckland Insight Meditation community, with Thursday evening talks in Westmere, and every Monday morning she hosts a short online sitting called Start Your Week Well. She also teaches Insight Dialogue, Gregory Kramer's relational form of meditation practised in pairs and small groups, and offers one-to-one meetings on a dana basis.

courses.title: Forest Refuge: February 2027
courses.description: Personal retreat at the Forest Refuge in Barre, Massachusetts, guided during February by Jill Shepherd and Nakawe Cuebas Berrios. Stays of seven nights or more are accepted, for meditators with substantial earlier retreat experience.
courses.price: From $115 USD per night (2027 sliding scale $115–$355 per night; seven-night minimum)

courses.title: Finding the Heart of Wisdom: Nine-Day Insight Meditation Retreat
courses.description: A nine-day residential retreat on the Coromandel Peninsula, co-taught with Di Robertson, working with the four foundations of mindfulness and the four heart qualities. Days mix silent and guided sitting, walking, some meditation in pairs or small groups, and teacher interviews; best suited to people who have sat at least one silent retreat before.

courses.title: Seeing Clearly, Finding Freedom: Nine-Day Retreat
courses.description: A nine-day retreat at the Blue Mountains Insight Meditation Centre in New South Wales on seeing impermanence, unsatisfactoriness and not-self directly. It combines mindfulness and brahmavihara practice with some relational meditation and is open to people with previous retreat experience.

courses.title: Start Your Year Well 2027
courses.description: A drop-in online day of practice on 2 January 2027 (1 January in the Americas), with a lightly guided half-hour sit every hour and reflection prompts in between. Suitable for beginners and offered on a donation basis.

courses.title: Individual Meetings
courses.description: One-to-one practice meetings in person or by video call, when her schedule allows. They are offered on a donation basis and booked through her online calendar.

free_resources.title: Dharma Talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: Jill's archive of retreat talks and guided meditations, free to stream or download.

free_resources.title: Start Your Week Well: Monday Morning Online Sitting
free_resources.description: A free half-hour Zoom meditation on Monday mornings, hosted by Jill with the Auckland and Blue Mountains insight communities. Everyone is welcome.
